\[
x^{\mu} = ({\tau}, {x}, {y}, {\eta}),\qquad g_{\mu\nu} = \mathrm{diag}(-1, 1, 1, {\tau}^2),\qquad u^{\mu} = (u^{\tau}, u^{x}, u^{y}, 0),\quad u^{\tau} = \sqrt{\left(u^{x}\right)^2+\left(u^{y}\right)^2+1}
\]
The first moment is the projected divergence of the charm stress tensor:

\begin{gather*}
\nabla_{\mu}(n\,u^{\mu} + \nu^{\mu}) = 0,\qquad \frac{D_{s}}{T}\,\Delta^{\mu}{}_{\lambda}\nabla_{\nu}T_{Q}^{\nu\lambda} + \nu^{\mu} = 0 \\
T_{Q}^{\alpha\beta} = (n h - P_{0})\,u^{\alpha}u^{\beta} + P_{0}\,\Delta^{\alpha\beta} + h\,(u^{\alpha}\nu^{\beta} + \nu^{\alpha}u^{\beta}),\qquad P_{0} = n T \\
n = n(T, \alpha),\quad h = h(T),\qquad \tau_{n} = D_{s}h/T,\quad \kappa = D_{s}\,\partial_{\alpha}n
\end{gather*}
At rest the current relaxes to

\[
\nu^{i} = -\kappa\,\partial_{i}\alpha - \frac{D_{s}}{T}\,(n + T\,\partial_{T}n)\,\partial_{i}T
\]
Relative to the $\nabla\alpha$ row of the previous section, the current equation gains (HC-C3, HC-C5)

\[
\frac{D_{s}}{T}(n + T\,\partial_{T}n)\,\nabla^{\mu}_{\perp}T + \tau_{n} n\,a^{\mu} + \tau_{n}\Delta^{\mu}{}_{\lambda}\,\nu^{\sigma}\nabla_{\sigma}u^{\lambda} + \nu^{\mu}\Bigl(\tau_{n}\theta + \frac{D_{s}}{T}\,Dh\Bigr),\qquad a^{\mu} = Du^{\mu}
\]
Fields and rows as before:

\begin{gather*}
\phi = ({\alpha}, {\nu^{x}}, {\nu^{y}}),\qquad \nu^{\tau} = \frac{{\nu^{x}} {u^{x}}+{\nu^{y}} {u^{y}}}{{u^{\tau}}} \\
A_t\,\partial_{\tau}\phi + A_x\,\partial_{x}\phi + A_y\,\partial_{y}\phi + S = 0
\end{gather*}
